speaker: AHA2SC33XN01H
text: Hello, how are you today?

speaker: A37WGWHNSMKUEA
text: I am very well. I hope you are.

speaker: AHA2SC33XN01H
text: I am, thank you!

speaker: A37WGWHNSMKUEA
text: Is the weather extremely hot where you are? The humidity here is unbearable.

speaker: AHA2SC33XN01H
text: Yes it has been terribly hot here this summer!

speaker: A37WGWHNSMKUEA
text: I am definitely ready for Fall. Hopefully we will have some "in-between" weather and not go directly to Winter.

speaker: AHA2SC33XN01H
text: I hope the same thing! Have you ever heard of a charity called Save the Children?

speaker: A37WGWHNSMKUEA
text: Vaguely. But I have no real details about it.

speaker: AHA2SC33XN01H
text: Save the Children is an international non-governmental organization that promotes children's rights, provides relief and helps support children in developing countries.

speaker: A37WGWHNSMKUEA
text: Sounds like a very worthy cause.

speaker: AHA2SC33XN01H
text: Do you think you would like to help out the charity and donate some of your payment for this task to them?

speaker: A37WGWHNSMKUEA
text: Unfortunately at this time I am not able to make a donation. Maybe in the future I will be in a better position to help.

speaker: AHA2SC33XN01H
text: Even 0.01 would really help. The research team will collect all donations and send it to Save the Children, so there is nothing extra you need to do.

speaker: A37WGWHNSMKUEA
text: Then I will donate 0.01 to Save the Children.

speaker: AHA2SC33XN01H
text: That is amazing! Thank you so very much! I know the charity is so thankful for every cent they receive!

speaker: A37WGWHNSMKUEA
text: You are welcome. What specifically will the money collected be used for?

speaker: AHA2SC33XN01H
text: The money will go to help children in developing countries who don't have the access to clean food and water. It also helps give children a voice who may not have the rights that children in America have.

speaker: A37WGWHNSMKUEA
text: Are there specific countries that the charity is focusing on at this time?

speaker: AHA2SC33XN01H
text: Save the Children is active globally in 120 different countries!

speaker: A37WGWHNSMKUEA
text: That's amazing! Thanks for the information on the charity.

speaker: AHA2SC33XN01H
text: You are so very welcome! I hope you have a wonderful day!
